description: This file declares an interface class INeedMediaDataThread within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. The class provides pure virtual methods for queuing events and stopping a media data thread, serving as an abstraction for thread management related to media data handling.

classes.name: INeedMediaDataThread
classes.description: An interface class defining methods for managing a media data thread, including queuing events and stopping the thread.

methods.name: queueEvent
methods.description: Pure virtual method to enqueue an event in the media data thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Pure virtual method to stop the media data thread.
